answer: Artifact-filing bond: each identity locks 70 credit and files an umber pigment swatch in a public registry to block bulk fakes. One key binds each pigment batch; a rented swatch cannot serve twice. A gale audit summons 5% of filings per epoch, checking shade, serial, thread; a copied seal or broken thread burns the bond. The k-th costs 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,032,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest filers pay 35 once and recover the bond.
